rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something agrees exactly with a fact, standard, or measurement.

example.english: This answer is exact and matches the standard perfectly.
example.traditional: 呢個答案係準確嘅，同標準完全吻合。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 daap3 on3 hai6 zeon2 kok3 ge3 tung4 biu1 zeon2 jyun4 cyun4 man5 hap6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when demanding money, goods, or a payment from someone.

example.english: They exact three hundred dollars from me as a handling fee.
example.traditional: 佢向我索取三百蚊手續費。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hoeng3 ngo5 sok3 ceoi2 saam1 baak3 man1 sau2 zuk6 fai3

rows.note: Use this for an authority imposing and collecting taxes, fees, or other compulsory payments.

example.english: The government will exact this fee.
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 wui5 zing1 sau1 ni1 hong6 fai3 jung6

rows.note: Use this when the payment or performance is enforced by forcing A to do V, especially obedience or handing something over.

example.english: They exact my obedience by forcing me to hand over my password.
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 bik1 ngo5 gaau1 ceot1 mat6 maa5

rows.note: Use this when the demand is extortionate and involves threats or coercion, typically for money or property.

example.english: Someone tried to exact one hundred thousand dollars from me by threatening me with the photos.
example.traditional: 有人用相片威脅我，勒索十萬蚊。
example.jyutping: jau5 jan4 jung6 soeng2 pin2 wai1 hip3 ngo5 lak6 sok3 sap6 maan6 man1

rows.note: Use this for a person or method that is habitually careful, accurate, and methodical.

example.english: I am always exact in my work.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zou6 je5 jat1 hoeng3 hou2 jim4 gan2

rows.note: Use this for the precise or definite wording of a statement, instruction, or concept.

example.english: The terms of this contract are exact and leave no room for ambiguity.
example.traditional: 呢份合約嘅條款寫得好明確，冇任何含糊。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 ge3 tiu4 fun2 se2 dak1 hou2 ming4 kok3 mou5 jam4 ho4 ham4 wu4

rows.note: Use this for the strict aspect of an exact command, rule, or requirement.

example.english: This is an exact, strict rule: even being one minute late is not allowed.
example.traditional: 呢條規定好嚴格，遲到一分鐘都唔得。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 gwai1 ding6 hou2 jim4 gaak3 ci4 dou3 jat1 fan1 zung1 dou1 m4 dak1
